answer: Price entry by the tide of the ocean: each epoch the desk sets one jade bond for a new identity, and the bond doubles whenever signups pass one hundred names, staying doubled until two calm epochs. An honest agent joins once, pays a single jade, and keeps its seat. An attacker flooding a thousand fakes in one surge pays the doubled price on every late fake, so the thousandth costs eight or sixteen jade and the flood's bill grows faster than its numbers. Like a juniper adding one ring a year, the price moves one step per epoch, so honest agents can plan while a surge still bankrupts itself.
